facts.text: The original building dates to the 11th century but did not become a hotel until the late 1800s, when Pantaleone Caruso ran it as a pensione.
facts.excerpt: The original ivy-clad building dates to the 11th century but didn’t become a hotel until the late 1800s, when Pantaleone Caruso ran it as a pensione

facts.text: The pensione drew Virginia Woolf and other Bloomsbury figures, and later Jackie Kennedy, Humphrey Bogart and Greta Garbo.
facts.excerpt: drawing Virginia Woolf and other Bloomsbury types, and later Jackie Kennedy, Humphrey Bogart, and Greta Garbo

facts.text: Belmond took over the hotel in 2000 and began a four-year renovation, bringing in art historians and archaeologists.
facts.excerpt: The Belmond group took it over in 2000 and began a four-year period of renovation, bringing in art historians and archaeologists while updating its design.

facts.text: Almost all rooms have private terraces or gardens, and original frescoes and vaulted ceilings feature in the rooms.
facts.excerpt: Almost all have private terraces or gardens, and the original frescoes and vaulted ceilings add to the feeling of absolute splendor.

facts.text: Balconies overlook the Tyrrhenian Sea, and every room and suite is unique with historical details.
facts.excerpt: balconies overlook the Tyrrhenian Sea, and the interiors are airy and elegant. Every room and suite in this palace is unique, featuring intriguing historical details.

facts.text: Villa Margherita is a standalone guesthouse with a private terrace overlooking the sea.
facts.excerpt: Villa Margherita is the recently added standalone guesthouse, with a private terrace overlooking the sea

facts.text: Ristorante Il Pantaleone serves menus by Chef Armando Aristarco, with Bar Caruso for a nightcap.
facts.excerpt: Taste the best of Chef Armando Aristarco’s menus at Il Pantaleone, followed by an indulgent nightcap at Bar Caruso.

facts.text: Caruso Grill offers casual poolside dining.
facts.excerpt: Casual poolside dining at Caruso Grill

facts.text: The Adagio Bar sits among the palace's historic interiors and 18th-century frescoes and is inspired by the region's botanicals and citrus groves.
facts.excerpt: Framed by the palace’s historic interiors and 18th-century frescoes, our new bar is a love letter to Italy's glittering coast, inspired by the region’s botanicals and citrus groves.

facts.text: La Piscina is the pool club, where guests enjoy poolside leisure or wellness services.
facts.excerpt: La Piscina is where our guests indulge in poolside leisure or experience the finest wellness services.

facts.text: A massage can be had in a gazebo in the garden.
facts.excerpt: you can have a massage in a gazebo in the garden.

facts.text: Weekly classes include pasta and pizza making.
Ravello is steps away, with restaurants on the square for a drink and ceramics shopping.
facts.excerpt: Just steps away is Ravello, great for a drink in one of the restaurants on the square and ceramics shopping.

facts.text: It is a 1.25-hour drive from Naples Airport (NAP).
It is a 17-minute drive from Amalfi town.
It is a 1-hour drive from Positano.
Private dining is available for up to 90 guests.
Condé Nast Traveler lists Readers' Choice Awards for the hotel in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
